population_density_geo10.long_description: Population density calculated as persons per square mile, combining ACS 5-year total population estimates (table B01001) with Census TIGER/Line geographic data for land area. Density is computed as total population (B01001_001) divided by land area in square miles at Census tract, county, and block group levels. Values are available on both Census 2020 and Census 2010 geography boundaries.
population_density_geo10.long_name: Population density calculated as persons per square mile.
population_density_geo10.provenance: Population from ACS 5-year estimates, table B01001 (total population). Land area from Census TIGER/Line shapefiles. Density calculated as total population divided by land area in square miles.
population_density_geo10.short_description: Population density calculated as persons per square mile (2010 Census geography).
